description: The ManageEngine ADAudit Plus login page is open in Microsoft Edge. Log in with username 'admin' and password 'Admin@2024'. Then navigate to the Admin area (click the '...' menu in the top navigation bar, then select 'Admin'). In the left sidebar, click 'Notifications'. On the Notifications page, enter the email address 'soc-team@company.local' in the Email field, check the 'Event Collection Status' checkbox to enable notifications for event collection issues, and set the notification frequency (the 'Run every' interval) to '1 Hours'. Click 'Save & Run now' to save the notification configuration.
